findings.message: job `bad` runs ./dev before its toolchain is set up (ER-9: ./dev hashes and builds itself with the job's compiler)
findings.fix: Add `- uses: ./.gitea/actions/setup-rust` before the first step that runs `./dev` (the job then hashes and builds the tool with the pinned compiler). A justified case carries `# conformance: dev-before-toolchain — <why>`.
